evidence.field: File description, source, label, and reuse terms
evidence.text: The file page identifies 妹-oracle.svg as a vector depiction of 妹 in Shang oracle-script style. It links Sinica form 43.ECF6 and records the source notation 拾11.11, 合21568. Commons describes the image as a modern digital drawing, not an artifact photograph, and marks it public domain/CC0.
evidence.title: File:妹-oracle.svg — Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The official notice states that glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through the query interface are dedicated under CC0 1.0, within the limits of applicable law.
evidence.title: 小學堂字形演變資料庫版權聲明

evidence.text: The character page labels examples as oracle script (~1250–1000 BC), Spring and Autumn bronze (771–476 BC), Shuowen seal (~100 AD), and Eastern Han clerical (25–220 AD). It describes 女 as the meaning component and 未 as the sound component. These are reference labels and analysis, not evidence of a continuous graphic lineage.
evidence.title: 妹 — Dong Chinese dictionary

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The entry gives 女弟也、从女，未聲, fanqie 莫佩切, Mandarin mèi, and senses including younger sister, younger female relative, modest self-reference by a woman, and young woman. The entry lists literary examples but does not date the semantic developments.
evidence.title: [A00902] 妹 — 教育部《異體字字典》

It identifies the graphic as part of a modern SVG project and states public-domain terms with attribution appreciated but not required. search_audit.outcome: Opened the oracle-file description page and verified its form label, Sinica record citation, and CC0 status. The oracle and seal original-file links returned cache misses. The exact bronze page and Commons API request were inaccessible; bronze candidate omitted.

search_audit.outcome: Opened the official rights notice; it covers query-interface glyph images and glyph-attribute information under CC0 1.0. Opened Xiaoxuetang from the Commons source link, but the page did not expose a readable character-specific record in extracted text.

gaps: The exact Commons original image bytes were not retrievable through the browser tool, and the exact Commons API request was inaccessible. Image identity and terms are based on the inspected description page; pixel-level inspection is left to the downstream visual review.

The oracle drawing is linked to Xiaoxuetang record 43.ECF6 and carries a Commons CC0 statement, while Sinica's own notice independently applies CC0 to query-interface glyph images and attributes. The Sinica record itself did not render as readable form data in this pass.
The bronze redraw could not be evaluated because its exact description page returned a cache miss; no direct URL or rights claim is made for it.

items.period: Shang dynasty; file labels it Shang oracle script, with source notation 拾11.11, 合21568.
items.tradition: Shang oracle-bone script; modern vector redraw linked to Academia Sinica Xiaoxuetang form 43.ECF6.
items.caption: A modern redraw of a Shang oracle-script form of 妹, linked to Xiaoxuetang record 43.ECF6.
items.alt: Modern vector redraw labeled 妹 in Shang oracle-bone script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides a sourced early form example with a specific Sinica record reference and verified public-domain/CC0 description-page terms; illustrates the early form tradition without presenting the drawing as an artifact photograph.
items.rights: Public domain/CC0 1.0 as stated on the Commons description page; Sinica separately dedicates query-interface glyph images and glyph attributes under CC0 1.0.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw, not a photograph. The browser could not retrieve its image bytes for visual inspection, so the downstream image review should check that the rendered pixels match the proposed caption and character identity.
